en: Black‑and‑white historic street view showing a wide, mostly unpaved road lined with trees in the center and two‑story townhouses and shops on both sides. In the distance a church tower or similar spire rises above the roofs. The captions in red Gothic-style script at the top read "Königsbrück." on the left and "Weissbacherstrasse." on the right. German signage is visible on building facades, such as a business sign for an inn or restaurant. The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century European town postcard.
